title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Highways Authority Amendment Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Highways Authority Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVI OF 2011
ACT XVI OF 2011
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA HIGHWAYS
AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Highways
Authority Ordinance, 2001.
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,
Extraordinary,
29th September, 2011]
No.PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa/Bills/2011/47122, dated 29-9-2011.--The Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa Highways Authority (Amendment) Bill 2011 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 23rd September, 2011 and assented
to by the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 27th September, 2011 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Highways Authority
Ordinance, 2001 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No.XIX of 2001), for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
It
shall be enacted as follows:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Highways Authority (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
